Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

HelpSteer3-Preference as described in 2505.11475v2 · human annotation: Each HelpSteer3-Preference sample is assigned to 3 to 5 independent human annotators for preference feedback.

candidate.paperfull.helpsteer3.independent-human-labels

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • Humans choose preference direction/strength or invalidity and provide brief justifications. The paper permits internet fact-checking but prohibits LLM tools during annotation.
  • HelpSteer3-Preference: Open Human-Annotated Preference Data across Diverse Tasks and LanguagesLocator: PDF p. 4; 2.1 Dataset Construction / Preference Annotation, first paragraph

    3-5 independent

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

HelpSteer3-Preference as described in 2505.11475v2 · paper method: HelpSteer3-Preference does not contain samples at intersections of its General, STEM, Code and Multilingual areas.

candidate.paperfull.helpsteer3.missing-domain-intersections

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • An explicit example is code prompts written in a non-English language. The source also limits coverage to 14 programming and 13 natural languages and excludes other modalities.
  • HelpSteer3-Preference: Open Human-Annotated Preference Data across Diverse Tasks and LanguagesLocator: PDF p. 26; A Limitations, first paragraph

    does not contain samples

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

HelpSteer3-Preference as described in 2505.11475v2 · filtered: Postprocessing retains the three most agreeing preference annotations and excludes samples when their remaining disagreement is greater than two preference-strength points.

candidate.paperfull.helpsteer3.postfilter-consensus

  • Author-reported, version-specific full-source finding; not independently replicated or approved.
  • Samples with any invalid annotation are removed first. Overall preference averages and rounds the retained annotations; released ties are not used in reward-model training. Agreement statistics are post-filtering, not raw reliability.
  • HelpSteer3-Preference: Open Human-Annotated Preference Data across Diverse Tasks and LanguagesLocator: PDF p. 4; 2.1 Dataset Construction / Preference Post-Processing

    three annotations that agree most

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Scale AI annotated HelpSteer3.

candidate.supplier.scale_ai.helpsteer3-contribution

  • Scoped to the three named domains in HelpSteer3-Preference. The Multilingual domain is explicitly attributed to Translated, not Scale. No attribution to all HelpSteer3 configurations or downstream models is inferred.
  • Scoped source statement: NVIDIA’s pinned HelpSteer3 card attributes General, STEM, and Code domain annotations to Scale AI.
  • scale.helpsteer3-card pinned README.mdLocator: Captured extracted text lines 123-126; Preference / Domain

    collected data spanning four domains: General, STEM, Code
